notablePrerequisites:
Coalhauler Swine has lifelink.
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, triggering Dawnsire, dealing 100 damage to Coalhauler Swine.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing 100 damage to each player and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of damage dealt this way due to its lifelink.
